sections.Profile:
The Sopranos pinball machine, released by Stern in 2005, immerses players in the world of the hit HBO series. The gameplay challenges players to rise through the ranks to become the Boss, featuring various elements from the show including the dancing girls of the Bada Bing, Tony Soprano’s boat "The Stugots," a talking fish, and a safe that opens when hit by the ball.
